verdict.rationale: Square is well documented as a self-serve payments platform: sign-up-and-go online payments, card processing APIs, sandbox testing, and online payments landing page (squareup.com/payments/online-payments) all indicate a fast, no-approval-wait path to accepting card payments. This is consistent with Square's known merchant-of-record model enabling near-instant onboarding. Missing for 10: explicit first-party or independent evidence of actual sign-up-to-first-transaction time, and no hands-on account-approval timeline confirmation.
